summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing results from its May 7, 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders. All director nominees were elected, auditor KPMG LLP was reappointed, and an advisory resolution on executive compensation was approved. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed; this is a routine reporting of meeting outcomes. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 and contains no deal terms, strategic review, or change of control event.
